title: Test (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
SXSW London
Jury Award for Outstanding First Narrative Feature, Frameline Film Festival

Asian Premiere

Small-town amateur bodybuilder Eddie keeps his eyes firmly fixed on the trophy. Living in codependent lockstep with his loving, alcoholic, evangelical mother (played by Emmy-award winner Tammy Blanchard), he waits tables, moonlights as a cam model, and channels every ounce of his turmoil into sculpting the perfect physique. But when a reputable new coach and a rekindled old flame enter his life, an unexpected flicker of queer desire cracks his carefully built exterior wide open. As his most important competition looms and his mother’s faith tightens its grip, Eddie must face his biggest hurdle yet: his true self. A standout of Provincetown and Frameline, where it shared the Jury Award with LEVITICUS, director Sam McConnell and writer-star Brock Yurich conduct a taut, tender myotomy of masculinity, faith and the soft, frightened self beneath the muscle.
cast: Brock Yurich, Matthew Morrison, Tammy Blanchard, Paloma Garcia-Lee
